notes: BriefsToken (src/BriefsToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin Contracts 5.4.0. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 BRIEFS (18 decimals, 1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the ProjectFactory. There is no owner, minter, pauser, blocklist, transfer fee or burn hook, so every launch flow (factory to MerkleDistributor, distributor to claimants, the single-sided pool seed through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager, and swaps) moves exactly the amount requested and the supply can never grow or shrink after construction. No exemption lists are needed because nothing is taxed, so the token does not take $factory, $poolManager or $launchNumber. The runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT and no payable function. There are no application contracts and no initialization calls. The pool pairs with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 at the launch policy's 1.25% fee; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply, so pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
